Name: Legendary Blades
Author: DeyvidMods
Description:
Legendary Blades adds eight powerful legendary swords to Stardew Valley, each with its own identity, appearance, stats, and an evolved form waiting to be awakened.

These weapons aren't simply handed to you.

Your progress as an adventurer determines when their secrets are revealed.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚔ LEGENDARY BLADES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Eight unique legendary swords can eventually become available at the Adventurer's Guild.

Each blade has:

• A unique appearance
• Individual combat stats
• Its own strengths and characteristics
• A legendary evolved form
• Full compatibility with the Volcano Forge
• Support for normal forging and enchantments

The eight base blades are:

• Stormbreaker
• Frostbite
• Emberfang
• Voidreaver
• Verdant Edge
• Bloodmoon
• Sunforged
• Soulrender

[size=4]But obtaining them is only the beginning.[/size]

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⛏ PROVE YOURSELF IN THE MINES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Marlon has spent years watching adventurers enter the mines.

Most never go very far.

Reach Floor 100 of the regular Mines and Marlon will finally consider you ready for something more.

The following morning, you'll receive a letter from him.

After reading it, Marlon's collection of eight Legendary Blades becomes available for purchase at the Adventurer's Guild.

These weapons are deliberately expensive.

Legendary weapons aren't meant for inexperienced adventurers.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💀 DESCEND INTO SKULL CAVERN
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Marlon hasn't told you everything about these weapons.

To discover their true potential, you'll need to prove yourself again.

Reach Floor 150 of Skull Cavern.

After accomplishing this feat, Marlon will send another letter revealing the final secret of the Legendary Blades:

They can evolve.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔥 AWAKEN THE BLADES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Take a Legendary Blade to the Volcano Forge on Ginger Island.

Using Galaxy Souls, the weapon can gradually absorb their power.

After absorbing three Galaxy Souls, the blade awakens and transforms into its evolved legendary form.

Every one of the eight swords has its own evolution.

8 base weapons.

8 evolved weapons.

16 unique forms in total.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ FORGE & ENCHANTMENT COMPATIBILITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Legendary Blades are designed to work naturally with Stardew Valley's Volcano Forge.

You can forge and enchant your weapon before completing its legendary evolution.

When the blade finally awakens, its existing forge and enchantment effects are preserved.

Your upgraded weapon remains truly yours.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📜 PROGRESSION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The complete progression is:

1. Explore the regular Mines.
2. Reach Floor 100.
3. Receive Marlon's first letter the following morning.
4. Read the letter.
5. Purchase Legendary Blades at the Adventurer's Guild.
6. Continue your journey into Skull Cavern.
7. Reach Floor 150.
8. Receive Marlon's second letter.
9. Discover the secret of the blades.
10. Travel to the Volcano Forge.
11. Use three Galaxy Souls.
12. Awaken your Legendary Blade.

Your progress is saved permanently.

Once you've earned Marlon's trust as an adventurer and unlocked the blades, you won't lose access after saving, quitting, or restarting the game.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📦 REQUIREMENTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

No expansion mod is required.

Legendary Blades works as a standalone SMAPI mod.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚔ YOUR JOURNEY. YOUR BLADE.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Reach the depths of the Mines.

Survive Skull Cavern.

Discover Marlon's secret.

And awaken a weapon worthy of a legendary adventurer.
